name: EIZO Corporation
summary: EIZO Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells visual display systems, amusement monitors, and imaging system software in Japan and internationally. It provides LCD, color management, and home entertainment monitors; operating room solutions; and medical monitor solutions. The company also offers industrial monitors; and ATC visual display solutions, such as primary control monitors, tower monitors, encoding and streaming solutions, data capture and content management solutions, and graphics boards, as well as other accessories.
